sloka: शत्रुघ्नशरनिर्भिन्नो लवणः स निशाचरः ।पपात सहसा भूमौ वज्राहत इवाचलः ।। ७.६९.३७ ॥
transliteration: śatrughnaśaranirbhinno lavaṇaḥ sa niśācaraḥ ।papāta sahasā bhūmau vajrāhata ivācalaḥ ।। 7.69.37 ॥

translations.english: That demon Lavana, pierced by Shatrughna's arrow, suddenly fell to the ground like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt.
